differences.detail: All six templates differ in whitespace. Harmfulness summarization removes example categories, instruction-following revision changes typography, and harmfulness revision shortens/edits sentences. Agent architecture matches, but prompts are not verbatim upstream.
Port accumulates gradients/momentum in raw pixel coordinates; upstream uses normalized image coordinates and BF16 channelwise step/constraint tensors. Exact numerical parity is not established.
Upstream saves each optimized image and reloads its PNG before the next round; port retains floating-point state across rounds, quantizing only the feedback image and final artifact.
Port retries malformed revision output with an additional correction prompt; upstream indexes its parsed result and can fail.
Simulator HarmBench judge conditions on original behavior. JPS official main saves and judges the complete steered/prefix-constrained input; measure both explicitly.
Author harmbench_standard.json and clean.jpeg are absent. README links TAP training subset; released inference artifacts are available.

Not included in the current full-run simulator script. Paper section 4 uses all-test denominator, section 5.1 says ASR-success denominator, while released quality_evaluate.py scores every supplied response. Do not conflate this with ASR.
